species.name: Killdeer
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Large dark eye with orange-red orbital ring, two complete bold black breast bands, tawny-brown upperparts, bright orange rump in flight
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Double black neck/breast bands, slender alert build, white forehead and supercilium, flesh-pink legs
species.crux_caption: Chest closeup: Upper and lower black bands completely separated by white band; bright red-orange orbital eye-ring

diagnostics.mark: Two bold, complete black bands across pure white chest (only North American plover with two breast bands).
In flight, flashes a brilliant fiery orange-rufous rump and uppertail contrasting with dark brown back.
Large dark eye surrounded by a distinct bright orange-red orbital ring; loud, piercing 'kill-deer!' vocalization.

species.rule_out: Two complete black breast bands + bright orange-rufous rump + red eye-ring = Killdeer.

species.name: Semipalmated Plover
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Single complete bold black breast band, dark mud-brown upperparts, stubby orange bill with black tip, bright orange legs
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Compact build, single dark breast band, bright orange legs, short stubby two-toned bill
species.crux_caption: Mudflat view: Dark brownish mantle matching tidal mud; bold black forehead bar and white supercilium

diagnostics.mark: Single complete bold dark breast band encircling the neck (brownish in non-breeding, jet-black in breeding).
Short, stubby bill with bright orange base and black tip (all-dark in winter); bright orange to yellow-orange legs.
Dark earthy grayish-brown upperparts (conspicuously darker than the pale bleached sand of Piping Plover).

species.rule_out: Single complete dark breast band + dark brown upperparts + bright orange legs + stubby bill = Semipalmated Plover.

species.name: Piping Plover
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Extremely pale sandy mantle matching dry beach sand, single narrow black breast band (often broken), stubby orange bill, orange legs
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Pale bleached sand-colored back, narrow dark neck band, stubby orange-and-black bill, orange legs
species.crux_caption: Beach habitat: Exceptional camouflage on dry ocean sand; pale rump and white underparts

diagnostics.mark: Extremely pale, bleached sandy-gray upperparts perfectly matching dry coastal beach sand (ghostly pale compared to Semipalmated).
Narrow black to dusky neck band across upper chest, frequently broken or incomplete at center of breast.
Short stubby orange bill with black tip; bright orange legs; threatened coastal beach specialist.

species.rule_out: Ghostly pale sandy-white mantle + narrow/broken breast band + orange legs = Piping Plover.

species.name: Black-bellied Plover (Fall / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Large stout plover, heavy black bill, cold silver-gray spangled upperparts, white underparts, slate-gray legs. Black axillaries in flight
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Bulky heavy-chested posture, cold silver-gray spangling, stout dark bill, dark gray legs
species.crux_caption: Flight crux: Diagnostic jet-black axillaries ('black armpits') beneath wings and stark white rump in flight

diagnostics.mark: 100% DIAGNOSTIC IN FLIGHT: Jet-black axillaries ('black armpits') on the underwing linings and crisp white rump.
Largest North American plover; heavy barrel-chested build; stout, thick black bill.
Cold, pale silver-gray spangling on mantle (completely lacks warm golden tones of American Golden-Plover).

species.rule_out: Large stout plover + cold silver-gray spangling + heavy black bill + jet-black underwing 'armpits' = Black-bellied Plover.

species.name: American Golden-Plover (Fall)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Slender attenuated build, long primary projection past tail, warm golden-buff spangling, bold whitish supercilium, dusky underwings
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Slender graceful structure, warm yellowish-gold spangled mantle, bold pale eyebrow, long wings extending well past tail
species.crux_caption: Comparison view: Direct side-by-side comparison with Black-bellied Plover (left); Golden-Plover (right) is slimmer with warm golden spangling, smaller bill, and wings extending far past tail tip

diagnostics.mark: Uniform dusky-gray underwing linings and axillaries in flight (completely lacks the jet-black armpits of Black-bellied Plover).
Warm golden-yellow and buff spangles covering dark brown upperparts; prominent pale whitish-buff supercilium.
Slender, attenuated body with long wings; primary tips project significantly (1-2 cm) beyond the tail tip.

species.rule_out: Slender plover + warm golden spangles + long primary projection + dusky underwings (no black armpits) = American Golden-Plover.

species.name: Greater Yellowlegs
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Long heavy bill (1.5x head length, distinctly upturned/recurved), long bright yellow legs, checkered grayish-brown mantle
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Long heavy bill with visible slight upward curve, heavy chest checkering, long bright yellow legs
species.crux_caption: Bill closeup: Bill is clearly 1.5x longer than the distance from bill base to nape, with a pale gray base and upturned tip

diagnostics.mark: Long, stout bill that is 1.5x the length of the head, with a distinct slight upward curve (recurved) toward the tip.
Very long, bright butter-yellow legs; robust, heavy-chested body (roughly 25-30% larger than Lesser Yellowlegs).
Raucous, piercing 3 to 4 note descending whistle: 'tew-tew-tew' (Lesser usually gives 1 or 2 softer notes).

species.rule_out: Heavy upturned bill 1.5x head length + bright yellow legs + 3-4 note call = Greater Yellowlegs.

species.name: Lesser Yellowlegs
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Dainty slender build, straight needle-like black bill (1.0x head length, never upturned), bright yellow legs, fine neck streaking
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Dainty petite build, perfectly straight slender all-black bill, long bright yellow legs
species.crux_caption: Head closeup: Bill is slender, straight, and strictly equal to the head length (1.0x head length, never curved)

diagnostics.mark: Slender, straight, needle-fine all-black bill that is roughly equal to head length (1.0x head length, never upturned).
Delicate, slender, dove-proportioned body with long bright yellow legs; much lighter and more buoyant than Greater.
Soft, mellow 1 or 2 note flight call: 'tyew' or 'tyew-tyew' (never loud piercing triple whistles).

species.rule_out: Straight needle-like bill equal to head length + dainty build + bright yellow legs = Lesser Yellowlegs.

species.name: Solitary Sandpiper
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Bold white eye-ring, dark unstriped olive-brown upperparts finely speckled with white, dull greenish-olive legs, barred outer tail
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Prominent white eye-ring on dark face, fine white speckling across dark back, dull olive legs, woodland pool habitat
species.crux_caption: Eye-ring & back detail: Bold white eye-ring contrasting with dark face, fine neat white speckling across slate-brown mantle, dull greenish legs

diagnostics.mark: Stark, bold, complete white eye-ring contrasting against dark dusky face.
Very dark olive-brown upperparts finely sprinkled with neat white spots; in flight wings are completely dark with NO wingstripe.
Dull olive-green legs (not bright yellow!); outer tail feathers boldly barred with black and white; favors quiet freshwater puddles.

species.rule_out: Bold white eye-ring + dark white-speckled back + unstriped dark wings + olive legs = Solitary Sandpiper.

species.name: Spotted Sandpiper (Breeding)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Dense bold dark spots covering pure white breast and belly, greenish-bronze back, pinkish-orange bill, horizontal teetering posture
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Bold black leopard spots covering white breast and belly, orange bill with dark tip, constant bobbing tail
species.crux_caption: Teetering stance: Horizontal body carriage with perpetual rear-end teetering; greenish-bronze mantle

diagnostics.mark: Pure white breast and belly densely covered in bold, distinct, dark round spots (unique among North American shorebirds).
Perpetual nervous teetering/bobbing of the tail and rear body; stiff, trembling, cupped-wing fluttering flight over water.
Pinkish-orange bill with dark tip; unpatterned warm greenish-bronze upperparts.

species.rule_out: Dense bold round belly spots + perpetual teetering + orange bill = Breeding Spotted Sandpiper.

species.name: Spotted Sandpiper (Fall / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Immaculate unspotted white underparts, diagnostic clean white vertical shoulder spur in front of wing, plain brownish-gray back
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Clean white underparts, distinct white spur rising vertically in front of wing, pale yellowish legs, teetering gait
species.crux_caption: Shoulder closeup: Crisp white vertical wedge cutting up into brown breast side in front of the wing bend

diagnostics.mark: 100% DIAGNOSTIC CRUX: A crisp, bright white vertical finger/spur extending upward in front of the wing onto the side of the breast.
Spots completely absent; immaculate white underparts with dusky brownish wash at sides of neck; compulsive tail bobbing.
Distinctive stiff-winged, trembling fluttering flight on arched downward wings, showing a bold white wingstripe.

species.rule_out: Plain white underparts + crisp white shoulder spur in front of wing + compulsive tail teetering = Non-Breeding Spotted Sandpiper.

species.name: Least Sandpiper
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: World's smallest peep, diagnostic yellowish-green legs (only common peep with pale legs!), fine decurved bill, warm brown tones
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Diminutive tiny size, bright yellowish-green legs, fine droop-tipped bill, warm brownish mantle
species.crux_caption: Legs closeup: Yellowish-green legs clearly visible on mud (all other common peeps have black legs!); hunched posture

diagnostics.mark: 100% DIAGNOSTIC CRUX: Bright greenish-yellow to pale olive legs (all other common North American peeps have solid black legs!).
World's smallest shorebird (sparrow-sized); typically feeds in a hunched, crouched, creeping posture along high muddy edges.
Fine, slender, decurved black bill with a drooping tip; warm rufous-brown tones across mantle and streaked breast.

species.rule_out: Tiny peep + pale yellowish-green legs + fine drooping bill + warm brown tones = Least Sandpiper.

species.name: Semipalmated Sandpiper
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Small peep, solid black legs, short straight tubular blunt-tipped black bill, cold grayish-brown upperparts, white underparts
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Solid black legs, short straight blunt bill, cold grayish scalloped mantle, white belly
species.crux_caption: Bill closeup: Bill is short, straight, and tubular with a blunt rounded tip (not fine or drooping)

diagnostics.mark: Short, straight, stout, tubular black bill with a blunt rounded tip (never droop-tipped like Western or Least).
Solid jet-black legs (partially webbed toes, hence 'semipalmated').
Cold, neutral grayish-brown upperparts with pale feather fringes; neat light breast streaking.

species.rule_out: Small peep + solid black legs + short straight blunt-tipped bill + cold gray mantle = Semipalmated Sandpiper.

species.name: Western Sandpiper
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Peep with longer droop-tipped black bill with thick base, solid black legs, rufous-edged upper scapulars, flank chevrons
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Noticeably long bill with distinctly drooping tip and thickened base, black legs, rufous scapular patch
species.crux_caption: Bill & breast: Thick bill base tapering to a fine downcurved tip; arrow-shaped chevron streaks on breast and flanks

diagnostics.mark: Noticeably longer bill with a noticeably thickened, stout base that tapers to a fine, distinctly drooping/downcurved tip.
Upper scapulars show bright rufous-chestnut feather edges contrasting with grayer lower back; arrow-shaped chevrons on flank.
Solid black legs; probes in deeper water than Semipalmated Sandpiper with rhythmic head-stitching.

species.rule_out: Peep with black legs + longer droop-tipped bill with thick base + rufous upper scapulars = Western Sandpiper.

species.name: White-rumped Sandpiper
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Elongate attenuated profile, primaries projecting far beyond tail, decurved bill with pale lower base, pure white horseshoe rump
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Long elegant wings extending well beyond tail tip, pale base to lower mandible, neat flank streaks
species.crux_caption: Breeding plumage profile: Rich rufous-edged upper scapulars, fine dark chevron streaks along flanks, and long wingtips projecting past tail

diagnostics.mark: 100% DIAGNOSTIC IN FLIGHT: Solid, pure snow-white horseshoe band completely across the rump and uppertail coverts.
Very long, crossed primary tips projecting far beyond the tail tip, giving an elongate, horizontal profile.
Slightly decurved dark bill with a distinctive pale flesh-orange spot at the base of the lower mandible; fine chevron streaks along flanks.

species.rule_out: Pure white horseshoe rump in flight + long primary projection past tail + pale base to lower mandible = White-rumped Sandpiper.

species.name: Sanderling (Fall / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Gleaming pure white underparts and face, pale pearl-gray back, prominent black carpal shoulder patch, black bill and legs
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Dazzling pale white plumage, dark shoulder patch, stout black bill, black legs, sprinting along ocean surf
species.crux_caption: Flight wingstripe: Broad, gleaming white wingstripe contrasting against black flight feathers; only 3 toes (no hind toe)

diagnostics.mark: Whitest shorebird on the beach: dazzling snowy-white face, breast, and underparts with pale pearl-gray mantle.
Prominent, contrasting blackish carpal patch on folded wing bend; broad brilliant white wingstripe in flight.
Chases incoming and receding waves along ocean surf like a wind-up toy; feet lack a hind toe (hallux) entirely (3 toes).

species.rule_out: Dazzling white beach runner + black shoulder patch + stout black bill + wave-chasing behavior = Sanderling.

species.name: Pectoral Sandpiper
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Medium-sized peep with razor-sharp breast bib cutoff, bright yellowish legs, slightly decurved bill with yellowish base, pale buff mantle 'V's
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Diagnostic dense brown breast streaks ending abruptly at pure white belly, dull yellowish legs, slightly decurved bill with yellowish base
species.crux_caption: Bib crux: Distinct horizontal razor-sharp boundary line separating dark streaked chest from clean white underparts; scaly back with pale stripes

diagnostics.mark: 100% DIAGNOSTIC CRUX: Dense, heavy brownish streaking on breast cuts off abruptly in a sharp horizontal line against clean, stark white belly ('razor-sharp bib').
Medium, slightly decurved bill with diagnostic dull yellowish or greenish-horn base and dark tip; medium-length dull yellow to greenish-yellow legs.
Dark scaly upperparts with prominent pale buff/whitish mantle 'V' stripes; alert upright neck-stretching posture when alarmed ('telescoping neck').

species.rule_out: Razor-sharp breast bib cutoff at pure white belly + yellowish legs + slightly decurved bill with yellow base = Pectoral Sandpiper.

species.name: Dunlin (Fall / Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Distinctive long heavy black bill that distinctly curves and droops downward at the tip, hunched posture, uniform drab gray mantle
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Hunched droop-nosed silhouette, long downcurved bill, uniform brownish-gray basic plumage, black legs
species.crux_caption: Feeding view: Probing deep in tidal mud with distinctly decurved bill; immaculate white belly (black patch in breeding)

diagnostics.mark: Long, heavy, distinctly downcurved black bill with a noticeable droop at the tip ('droop-nosed' look).
Characteristic hunched, pot-bellied, neckless carriage while probing deep in mudflats.
Uniformly drab brownish-gray mantle and breast wash in fall/winter; unspotted white belly (famous black belly patch in spring).

species.rule_out: Hunched posture + long heavy bill with drooping tip + uniform drab gray plumage = Dunlin.

species.name: Short-billed Dowitcher
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Long straight snipe-like bill, flat forehead profile with gentle loral angle, uniform gray-brown upperparts, yellowish-green legs
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Straight heavy bill, sewing-machine vertical probing motion in tidal mud, yellowish-olive legs
species.crux_caption: Flight crux: Long white oval/cigar wedge extending from rump up the center of the lower back; rapid 3-note 'tut-tut-tut' call

diagnostics.mark: Flatter, more gently sloping forehead profile; pale supercilium runs straight back; bill is slightly shorter (roughly 2x head length).
Rapid vertical up-and-down 'sewing machine' probing motion; primarily found on coastal tidal mudflats and saltmarshes.
Diagnostic rapid, mellow 3-note flight call: 'tut-tut-tut'; tail bars have white bars wider than dark bars.

species.rule_out: Sewing-machine probing + white back wedge in flight + flat forehead + coastal saltmarsh + 3-note 'tut-tut-tut' = Short-billed Dowitcher.

species.name: Long-billed Dowitcher
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Extremely long straight snipe bill, steep high-crowned forehead with abrupt drop to bill, dark breast wash, yellowish-olive legs
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Exceptionally long bill, steep arched forehead, humpbacked posture, darker breast wash, freshwater preference
species.crux_caption: Voice crux: Diagnostic sharp, high-pitched single metallic 'keek!' call; tail has dark bars wider than pale bars

diagnostics.mark: Steep, high-crowned forehead with a distinct, abrupt right-angle drop to the bill base; extremely long bill (often >2.5x head length).
100% DIAGNOSTIC CRUX: A sharp, thin, high-pitched, metallic single note: 'keek!' or 'keek-keek!' (never mellow 3-note 'tut-tut-tut').
Strongly prefers freshwater marshes and managed impoundments over tidal flats; tail has black bars wider than pale bars.

species.rule_out: Sewing-machine probing + steep forehead + very long bill + sharp single 'keek!' call + freshwater = Long-billed Dowitcher.

species.name: Stilt Sandpiper
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Slender medium sandpiper, diagnostic long greenish-yellow stilt legs, slender black bill with distinct gentle droop at tip, bold white supercilium, whitish underparts with fine streaking, white rump
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Long greenish-yellow legs, slender bill drooping slightly at tip, bold white eyebrow, deep wading posture
species.crux_caption: Feeding crux: Decurved bill tip and long legs; often wades belly-deep with rapid vertical sewing-machine probing motion

diagnostics.mark: Long, slender, dark bill that gently decurved/droops towards the tip; probes with a rapid vertical 'sewing-machine' motion while wading belly-deep in water.
Diagnostic long, spindly, greenish-yellow to dull olive legs ('stilt legs'); frequently wades in deeper water than peeps or yellowlegs.
Prominent bold white supercilium (eyebrow) extending far behind the dark eye; flashes a solid white rump patch in flight (lacks dowitcher's white back wedge).

species.rule_out: Long greenish-yellow legs + decurved/droop-tipped bill + bold white supercilium + sewing-machine probing in deep water = Stilt Sandpiper.

species.name: Willet
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Heavy stocky build, stout straight grayish-black bill, uniform plain gray plumage, long bluish-gray legs. Bold black-and-white wings
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Unassuming stocky plain gray shorebird, thick straight bill, bluish-gray legs, coastal saltmarsh habitat
species.crux_caption: Flight explosion: Shocking brilliant black-and-white wing pattern ('piano keys') revealed the instant it takes flight

diagnostics.mark: 100% DIAGNOSTIC EXPLOSION: When taking flight, plain gray bird erupts with a shocking, brilliant black-and-white 'piano key' wing stripe.
Large, stocky, heavily built shorebird; thick, straight, heavy grayish-black chisel bill.
Long bluish-gray legs (never yellow!); completely plain, unpatterned battleship-gray plumage.

species.rule_out: Plain battleship-gray body + heavy straight bill + shocking black-and-white 'piano key' wings in flight = Willet.

species.name: Hudsonian Godwit
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Large graceful shorebird, long upturned two-toned bill (pink base, black tip), clean white supercilium, black underwings and white rump
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Elegant posture, long two-toned upturned bill, grayish-brown mantle, dark slate legs
species.crux_caption: Flight crux: Diagnostic solid jet-black underwing linings, crisp white rump band, and solid black tail

diagnostics.mark: Exceptionally long, slender bill that curves distinctly upward (recurved), with a bright flesh-pink basal half and jet-black tip.
100% DIAGNOSTIC REVIEW CRUX: Solid jet-black underwing coverts/axillaries, crisp white rump band, and solid black tail.
Large, elegant godwit; rare fall migrant through coastal impoundments and mudflats requiring detailed documentation.

species.rule_out: Long upturned two-toned pink/black bill + jet-black underwings + white rump & black tail = Hudsonian Godwit.
